subject: Service account provisioning audit & RBAC minimization
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clipperhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@clipperhealth.com
Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request — service accounts + RBAC minimization

Hi Grace,

As part of our upcoming SIG/SOC2 intake we need an evidence bundle that shows how Redwood handles service account provisioning and the steps you take to keep those identities least-privilege. Specifically the security team asked for:

- A mapping of active service accounts (owner, creation date, last used)
- SCIM delta or snapshot showing service-identity attributes and provisioning flows
- RBAC role definitions that apply to service accounts and a short explanation of any built-in role scoping
- Any attestation or owner-confirmation artifacts (signed PDFs or a self-attestation)

Can you confirm whether you can provide the above and whether Redwood can redact free-form email content before we ingest? We need the artifacts by EOD 2025-06-25 if possible.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
Director, Security Ops — ClipperHealth
security@clipperhealth.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clipperhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — service accounts + RBAC minimization

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all of that. Quick clarifying Qs so we scope correctly:

1) Do you want service accounts only (machine identities), or also service principals used by third-party integrations?
2) For "last used" — is a timestamp granularity of UTC second acceptable, or do you need session-level logs?
3) For redaction: we can provide a pre-redacted Drive folder with a manifest. We redact free-text only (commit messages, ticket descriptions) but keep structured attributes intact. Is that acceptable?

Plan: Jonas will assemble the mapping and SCIM snapshot, Marcus will extract the RBAC roles and add short scoping notes, and I will produce an attestation PDF signed by our compliance lead. We'll put everything in a shared Drive folder and send a link. Targeting delivery by 2025-06-20 to give you time to review before your 06/25 deadline.

If that timeline works, I'll start the bundle and share the link today.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0148
grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clipperhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Draft artifacts and access link — service account evidence

Tom / Grace — attaching the initial set of artifacts to the Drive folder and dropping a short summary here. Attachments are stubs in the folder; original extracts are included as CSV/JSONL/XLX per request.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cREDWOOD-clipper-evidence

What I pushed to the folder (files below are copies of our exports — sensitive free-text fields redacted per Grace's plan):
- service-account-mapping-20250531.csv (columns: account_id, owner_email, created_at_utc, last_used_utc, principal_type)
- scim-delta-snapshot-20250531.jsonl (SCIM user/service-identity snapshot; only provisioning attributes included)
- rbac-role-definitions-2025Q2.xlsx (sheets: roles, role_bindings, built_in_scopes)

Notes on scope and redaction:
- We removed ticket summaries and free-form "notes" fields from the CSV. Owner email and timestamps are intact.
- "Last used" is derived from our token-usage table (UTC timestamp). For older entries where tokens expired >1y ago, last_used is null.
- For role definitions we included a short "scoping_notes" column that explains typical use cases and the minimal privileges granted.

Grace: I'll also prepare a short README that maps each artifact to the SIG question numbers. Expect that in about 90 minutes.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior SRE, Platform Security
jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clipperhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@clipperhealth.com
Date: 2025-06-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — service accounts + RBAC minimization

Thanks Jonas — that looks like the right shape. Two asks from our side: 

1) Can Redwood include a short signed attestation (PDF) from your compliance lead confirming that owners were notified and validated? We need something that we can store with our SIG answers.
2) For the SCIM snapshot, can you confirm whether you include the "meta.lastModified" attribute? Our tooling uses that to reconcile reprovisioning.

If you can provide the attestation and confirm meta.lastModified is present, we'll mark the item "OK" on our side. Also, confirm delivery by EOD 2025-06-20 if possible.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Tom

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clipperhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2025-06-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Deliverable: service account evidence + attestation (redacted)

Tom — attaching final bundle to the same Drive folder. Summary of deliverables included in the root README.pdf and listed below. Per your redaction request we removed free-form ticket notes; structured owner emails and timestamps are unchanged.

Deliverables (in Drive):
- service-account-mapping-20250531.csv (CSV extract, redaction: notes column removed)
- scim-delta-snapshot-20250531.jsonl (includes meta.lastModified values)
- rbac-role-definitions-2025Q2.xlsx (role scoping notes included in "scoping_notes" column)
- service-account-attestation-clipper.pdf (signed by Compliance Lead, includes confirmation owners were contacted)
- README-evidence-mapping.pdf (maps artifacts to SIG question numbers and includes redaction log)

If you want us to upload the bundle to a secure transfer (or share via your portal) instead of Drive, we can do that — tell us the preferred transfer method.

Next steps we propose: 1) You confirm receipt and that meta.lastModified satisfies your tooling, 2) we schedule a 30-min walk-through if any of the artifacts need clarification.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
